command_representation: actual exec_command request cmd string; not process argv
fingerprint_method: cksum CRC and byte count; noncryptographic

request.cmd:
set -eu
fail() { printf '%s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
sum=0
count=0
while IFS= read -r price || [ -n "$price" ]; do
  case "$price" in ''|*[!0-9]*) fail "invalid price integer";; esac
  while [ "${price#0}" != "$price" ]; do price=${price#0}; done
  price=${price:-0}
  [ "${#price}" -le 9 ] || fail "price exceeds safe arithmetic bound"
  sum=$((sum + price))
  [ "$sum" -le 1000000000 ] || fail "sum exceeds safe arithmetic bound"
  count=$((count + 1))
done < inputs/prices.txt
[ "$count" -gt 0 ] || fail "no prices"
rate=$(/bin/cat inputs/tax-rate.txt)
printf '%s\n' "$rate" | /usr/bin/cmp -s - inputs/tax-rate.txt || fail "rate must be one line with LF"
case "$rate" in *.*) ;; *) fail "decimal rate required";; esac
whole=${rate%%.*}
fraction=${rate#*.}
case "$whole" in ''|*[!0-9]*) fail "invalid decimal whole part";; esac
case "$fraction" in ''|*[!0-9]*) fail "invalid decimal fractional part";; esac
[ "${#fraction}" -le 6 ] || fail "rate exceeds safe precision bound"
denominator=1
remaining=$fraction
while [ -n "$remaining" ]; do
  denominator=$((denominator * 10))
  remaining=${remaining#?}
done
while [ "${whole#0}" != "$whole" ]; do whole=${whole#0}; done
whole=${whole:-0}
while [ "${fraction#0}" != "$fraction" ]; do fraction=${fraction#0}; done
fraction=${fraction:-0}
[ "${#whole}" -le 3 ] || fail "rate exceeds safe arithmetic bound"
numerator=$((whole * denominator + fraction))
scaled=$((sum * numerator))
[ "$((scaled % denominator))" -eq 0 ] || fail "noninteger tax requires rounding guidance"
expected=$((scaled / denominator))
printf '%s\n' "$expected" | /usr/bin/cmp -s - output/tax.txt || fail "tax bytes do not match independently recomputed integer plus LF"
printf '%s\n' 'PASS C-TAX: independent source calculation and exact byte comparison'

result.output: PASS C-TAX: independent source calculation and exact byte comparison
